parts.text: 5 Three states of matter are solid, liquid and gas.

ms.label: 5(a)
ms.text:
1 mark each for any two of:
•
has a definite volume / fixed volume
•
takes the shape of its container / no fixed shape
•
flows over a surface / can be poured over a surface
•
cannot be compressed

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Complete Table 5.1 to show the motion and separation of particles in a solid and a liquid. Table 5.1 physical state motion of particles separation of particles solid liquid [4]

ms.label: 5(b)
ms.text:
solid:
motion: vibrating (1)
separation of particles: touching / (very) close (together) (1)
liquid:
motion: motion: sliding / moving over each other (1)
separation of particles: touching / close (together) (1)

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) Draw a line from each statement to the correct change of state. statement change of state [2] evaporating freezing condensing liquid nitrogen turns into solid nitrogen liquid cobalt changes into cobalt gas steam changes into liquid water

ms.label: 5(c)
ms.text:
all three correct = 2 marks
one correct = 1 mark
liquid nitrogen turns into solid nitrogen: freezing
liquid cobalt changes into cobalt gas: evaporating
steam changes into liquid water: condensing
